script:
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$r = [ordered]@{}
$r.utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$r.features = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_OptionalFeature | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Hyper-V|HypervisorPlatform|VirtualMachinePlatform|Subsystem-Linux' } | Select-Object Name,InstallState)
$r.hyperv_registry = @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Virtualization','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\HostComputeService') | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path=$_; exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) } }
$r.vm_configuration_dirs = @('C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Hyper-V','C:\Users\Public\Documents\Hyper-V','C:\Users\Eileen\VirtualBox VMs','C:\Users\Eileen\Documents\Virtual Machines') | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ path=$_; exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $_); children= if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) { @(Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath $_ | Select-Object Name,Mode) } else { @() } } }
$r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
& C:\Windows\System32\hcsdiag.exe list
Write-Output "HCSDIAG_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
& C:\Windows\System32\wsl.exe --list --verbose
Write-Output "WSL_LIST_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
